page.overview:
Who is Kerene Nagashi?

Kerene Nagashi was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and its Captain-General. She was also one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

She was tall and beautiful with short dark hair lightly touched with white. Her eyes were nearly black.

She was reputed to adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt.

Kerene was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of ., Kerene Nagashi|comp}} She stands above Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, but lower than Cadsuane Melaidhrin. Cadsuane said that "no one had come to the Tower who could match [herself] in a thousand years. No one to match Kerene or Meilyn in almost six hundred." There was "a sharp drop" between Kerene and Moiraine in terms of strength.
